cycle0158_refinement.eliminated_work: Hypothesis: after preserved successful GPU initialization and reviewed failure ordering, doing immutable host packing outside the device mutex may shorten lock hold and reduce concurrent proof waiting. It eliminates no required packing/bytes/arithmetic; contention may be zero.
cycle0158_refinement.added_costs: Potential earlier host allocation and coexistence of multiple staging buffers; reordered shape/poison/OOM error timing; ownership/lock handoff and fail-closed review. Do not move work based only on secs_fold.

cycle0158_refinement.integration_cost: Moderate only if real contention: source-ordered callback/mock control then native owner review. Global priority3 measurement refinement, not a scheduling patch.
cycle0158_refinement.exactness: Source/timer observation only; outside-mutex variant not implemented/tested.
cycle0158_refinement.privacy_soundness: No mask/private opening reuse; preserve initialization/shape/poison/failure/publication behavior and fresh call-local buffer lifetime. More concurrent private buffers increase capacity obligations.
cycle0158_refinement.compatibility: Existing Rust/CUDA GPU mutex seam; no new API/dependency needed for instrumentation. Locks do not imply useful overlap.

cycle0158_refinement.falsification: No mutex contention, proof work serialized for other reasons, memory cost excessive, or error-order/privacy/native-byte mismatch.
